requirements.requirement: The system must include a malpractice_measure object in the provider detail API response when evaluate_care_facade is invoked.
The system must populate malpractice_measure using the output from EVAL-P-MALPRACTICE-LOGIC-001 without altering its structure.
The system must include evidence_links within malpractice_measure and ensure each link is a valid URL string.
The system must include a field that explicitly distinguishes between unknown malpractice data and confirmed absence of malpractice actions.
The system must preserve compatibility with existing tool_router response schema without breaking existing consumers.
The system must return malpractice_measure as null or an object with unknown flags when upstream logic returns no data instead of omitting the field.
The system must ensure that malpractice_measure does not introduce any positive scoring signal when no malpractice is present.
The system must serialize malpractice_measure fields in a format consistent with existing provider detail JSON conventions.
The system must include action_count and severity_score fields in the malpractice_measure response when available.
The system must not fail the entire provider detail response if malpractice logic fails, and instead return malpractice_measure with an unknown status.
The system must handle malformed malpractice data from upstream logic by sanitizing or defaulting fields rather than propagating invalid structures.
The system must ensure that evidence_links are always returned as an array, even when empty.
The system must maintain backward-compatible field naming so existing clients parsing provider detail responses do not break.
The system must ensure that the malpractice_measure object is included in all provider responses regardless of provider state or specialty.
